name: mcp-services
description: Multi-tool MCP server for AI agents with 29 tools across web scraping, SEO analysis, screenshot and PDF generation, domain intelligence, content extraction, multi-chain EVM blockchain queries, and security toolkit. Free tier available with no auth required.

rawRecord.description: Multi-tool MCP server for AI agents with 29 tools across web scraping, SEO analysis, screenshot and PDF generation, domain intelligence, content extraction, multi-chain EVM blockchain queries, and security toolkit. Free tier available with no auth required.

REDIS_URL.description: Optional Redis backend for shared/distributed rate-limits

STRIPE_SK.description: Stripe API key for Pro subscriptions

TRUST_PROXY.description: Express trust proxy setting (false, true, hop count like 1, or subnet names/CIDRs like loopback/10.0.0.0/8)

MAX_SSE_PER_IP.description: Max concurrent SSE sessions per client IP

X402_TEST_MODE.description: Set to 1 only for local/offline testing; ignored in production

SSE_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated allowlist for Host header on /mcp/sse + /mcp/messages (e.g. mcp.example.com,localhost)

ALLOW_APIKEY_QUERY.description: Allow deprecated ?apikey= auth during migration. Default is true in non-production, false in production

X402_TX_CACHE_FILE.description: Persistent replay-protection cache for used x402 tx hashes

SSE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist for Origin header (full origins like https://app.example.com)

SSE_CONNECT_WINDOW_MS.description: SSE connect rate-limit window in ms

X402_MAX_TX_AGE_SECONDS.description: Maximum accepted payment tx age in seconds (stale txs are rejected)

SSE_CONNECT_MAX_PER_WINDOW.description: Max SSE connection attempts per IP per window

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_IP_ALLOWLIST.description: Optional CSV allowlist for webhook source IPs
